title: Finished work whose tests pass and whose check found nothing lands on its own instead of waiting for Daniel
tier_reason: changes the drain and the work module; git reverts it; behind the suites
ask:
Build the arrival rule (S-16; docs/QUEUE_TO_ZERO.md §4; the plain words are `arrival` in hq/data/work_policy.json). Do not survey the repo: every place you touch is named here.

1. hq/work.py line 83: add "landed" to STATES. In snapshot() (line ~953) count waiting_on_you exactly as before (needs_approval + for_review) and add `landed_today`: cards with state landed whose `landed.at` is today.
2. hq/drain.py write_back() (line ~1041) is the only place a drained card becomes for_review. Before it sets for_review, call a new `meets_landing_bar(item, rec, applied, suites)` that returns (True, "") or (False, reason). The bar, all four: item tier in (0, 1) — use `tier_checked` if the checker wrote one, else `tier`; `applied` is True and `suites` is a dict where every value's `ok` is true (for a tier-0 card with no diff, skip this gate); the checker verdict in rec["check"]["verdict"] is "pass", or "concerns" with an empty findings list; and no path in rec["files"] starts with docs/design/, docs/DEPLOY.md, ITCH_PAGE.md, .github/, or matches hq/data/releases.json. If it passes: `git add -- <rec files>` and `git commit -m <item title>` in REPO (never `git add -A`), set state "landed", `landed` = {at, sha, by: "drain"}, keep result/diff/check/suites as write_back already does. If it fails: set for_review exactly as today, and put the reason in item["diff"]["why_not_landed"].
3. hq/work.py: `POST /api/work/undo` with {id}: for a landed card, `git revert --no-edit <sha>`, set state for_review with a conversation line "Daniel undid the landing", and answer {ok, sha}. Add it beside /api/work/accept (line ~1041 in work.py).
4. hq/work.py _process_item (line ~676), the tier-0 lane: a finished tier-0 card whose follow_ups are all tier ≤ 1 (or none) lands the same way without a commit: state "landed", landed = {at, by: "worker"}; otherwise for_review as today.
5. hq/static/work.js: in the section list, add a fold "Landed without you" listing state landed cards (title, owner, when, and an Undo button that posts /api/work/undo). Do not change anything else on the page.
6. Tests: a unit test in a new tests/test_landing_bar.py (plain python, run with `python3 -m pytest` if present else `python3 tests/test_landing_bar.py`) that calls meets_landing_bar with a fake rec for each gate and asserts the reason.

Commit early and often in your worktree. Stay out of tests/test_runner.gd and the game code entirely; this item touches only hq/.
first_action: Read hq/drain.py write_back (line ~1041) and hq/work.py STATES (line 83), then write meets_landing_bar and its test first.
